With nearly two decades of experience, they specialize in managed IT services, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure management. They are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions, exceptional customer service, and long-term client partnerships. Our client fosters a fast-paced and collaborative environment, where innovation, technical expertise, and continuous learning are highly valued. Their team thrives on solving complex IT challenges, delivering strategic solutions, and maintaining a strong customer-first approach. The Senior Technical Analyst plays a key role in IT project execution, infrastructure management, and client support. The role requires a proactive and adaptable individual who can effectively manage technical solutions, provide advanced troubleshooting, and collaborate with internal teams to enhance service delivery. Client Support & Issue Resolution: Serve as a senior escalation point for complex IT issues, working closely with internal teams and clients to ensure high-quality support. MSP Operations & System Monitoring: Utilize RMM, PSA, and security platforms to proactively maintain client IT environments, ensuring system performance and reliability. Security & Compliance: Ensure IT systems comply with regulatory requirements and cybersecurity best practices. Documentation & Process Improvement: Develop technical documentation, refine IT processes, and implement automation solutions. Collaboration & Team Development: Work alongside account managers and technical teams to align IT services with business objectives and support long-term client success. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred. Industry certifications such as Microsoft (MCSA, MCSE), Azure, ITIL, or PMP are an asset. Qualifications: Ability to work versatile schedules including rotating on-call for after hour emergency calls, etc. Ability to work in office daily, with the flexibility to work from home when working on-call. (This is not a formal hybrid work position) Experience: Minimum 10+ years of IT infrastructure experience, including server, networking, and cloud technologies. Minimum 5+ years of experience within an MSP or IT service provider environment. Strong expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and Azure cloud services. Proficiency in networking (firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, security best practices). Ability to manage IT infrastructure projects, ensuring on-time and within-budget delivery. Hands-on experience with virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V) and automation tools. Skills: Exceptional interpersonal skills – Ability to build strong relationships with clients, team members, and leadership. Client-focused mindset – Actively listen, understand client needs, and provide solutions that put them at ease. Strong collaboration abilities – Work effectively within a team, ensuring seamless communication and knowledge sharing. Empathy & adaptability – Quickly assess client concerns, respond with patience, and tailor solutions to fit their needs. Clear and professional communication – Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a way that is accessible to all stakeholders. Problem-solving approach – Think critically to troubleshoot issues while maintaining a calm and supportive presence. Technical expertise in IT infrastructure – Experience with Windows Server, networking, virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V), and cloud technologies. Proficiency in IT security & monitoring tools – Knowledge of RMM, PSA, EDR/MDR, MFA, and cybersecurity best practices. Base Salary: $75,000-100,000+ per year Compensation is based on experience and qualifications. Full benefits package, including health coverage, professional development support, and performance-based incentives. Work Hours: Full-time, Monday – Friday. Participation in on-call rotation for critical incident response is required. Additional Notes: This opportunity does not include relocation. It will be the responsibility of the candidate should relocation be required. All applicants must be authorized to work in Canada to be considered for employment. We focus on temporary, direct hire (permanent) and temporary-to-direct hire placements in the corporate and industrial fields. The About Staffing team would like to thank everyone who applies. Please note we are only contacting applicants who meet the employer’s needs of the positions we are actively working on.

Provide basic troubleshooting for hardware, software, connectivity, and device performance issues.
